_comment: Away Guard lines. One list per category; each list is a shuffle bag, so nothing repeats until every line in it has been shown. {minutes} becomes the minutes guarded so far. Add your own in a guard_phrases.json next to Nib's config.json - it is merged with this list, never replaces it.
